title: Micro/nanoplastic concentration in human brain tissue

source.name: Bulk-phase nanoplastics in human tissues (autopsy study)
source.publisher: University of New Mexico Health Sciences (Campen et al.), Nature Medicine

notes: Analysis of post-mortem brain tissue samples found average micro/nanoplastic concentration rose from about 3,345 micrograms per gram in 2016 samples to about 4,917 in 2024 samples, a roughly 50% increase; scaled up, that is described as a plastic spoon's worth per brain.
